items.prompt: Use W3 data. Which trial has the higher recorded value, and by how much?
items.answer: Trial B; 8 milliliters of water collected.

items.prompt: Use W3 data. State one observation without claiming its cause.
items.answer: Trial B recorded 21 versus 13 in A; accept an accurate description without an unsupported causal claim.

practice.title: Art
practice.passage: Digital images can be built in parts. Layers separate elements for easier editing and arrangement. Credit reused assets and keep private information out of images.

items.prompt: Why use layers?
items.answer: To arrange and edit parts independently.

items.prompt: Plan a layered image on paper or digitally and revise one element. Use precise vocabulary, two supporting reasons or observations, and a limitation.
items.answer: Look for a relevant completed activity, an accurate concept, evidence or an example, and a reasoned explanation/revision. Accept varied justified responses. Do not grade beliefs or private experiences.

practice.title: Human Sciences
practice.passage: Sikhism began in Punjab with Guru Nanak and subsequent Gurus. The Guru Granth Sahib is central to Sikh religious life. Equality and service are important themes; individual practices vary.

items.prompt: Can similar actions have different meanings?
items.answer: Yes; motivations and interpretations can differ.

items.prompt: Locate Punjab and compare service as a religious practice with a nonreligious civic activity. Use precise vocabulary, two supporting reasons or observations, and a limitation.
items.answer: Look for a relevant completed activity, an accurate concept, evidence or an example, and a reasoned explanation/revision. Accept varied justified responses. Do not grade beliefs or private experiences.
